title: Portuguese (Brazil): 500 Most Common Words

sources.name: Original educational writing from general knowledge

description: For beginners learning Brazilian Portuguese: 500 useful common words and expressions with usage examples. A curated study selection, not an exact frequency ranking; Latin-script forms are repeated in answers.

cards.example: Eu moro aqui. = I live here.
